surface_mechanism_description: The incorporation of aluminum oxide in HfO2 gate dielectrics on Ge substrates is effective in providing a barrier to intermixing and bonding between the Hf in the dielectric and Ge, thereby improving interfacial properties.
evidence: The incorporation of aluminum oxide is effective in providing a barrier to intermixing and bonding between the Hf in the dielectric and Ge, which is the cause of poor device performance.
